{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module PaymentProcessor where

import Control.Concurrent (MVar, newMVar, takeMVar, putMVar, threadDelay, forkIO)
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Monad (when, unless, void, forM_)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Time.Clock (UTCTime, getCurrentTime, diffUTCTime)
import System.Environment (lookupEnv)
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe)
import Text.Read (readMaybe)

data PaymentOrder = PaymentOrder
  { orderId      :: !Int
  , orderAmount  :: !Double
  , orderSender  :: !String
  , orderRecv    :: !String
  , orderRate    :: !Double
  , orderTime    :: !UTCTime
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

data ProcessorConfig = ProcessorConfig
  { batchWindow    :: !Int       -- microseconds
  , maxBatchSize   :: !Int
  , rateSource     :: !String
  , enableOrdering :: !Bool
  } deriving (Show)

data ProcessorState = ProcessorState
  { pendingOrders :: TVar [PaymentOrder]
  , processedLog :: TVar [PaymentOrder]
  , currentRate   :: TVar Double
  , orderCounter  :: TVar Int
  }

-- Safe integer parsing helper: falls back to default on invalid input
parseIntEnv :: Int -> Maybe String -> Int
parseIntEnv def mval = fromMaybe def (mval >>= readMaybe)

loadConfig :: IO ProcessorConfig
loadConfig = do
  bw <- lookupEnv "BATCH_WINDOW_US"
  ms <- lookupEnv "MAX_BATCH_SIZE"
  rs <- lookupEnv "RATE_SOURCE"
  eo <- lookupEnv "ENABLE_FAIR_ORDERING"
  return ProcessorConfig
    { batchWindow    = parseIntEnv 50000 bw
    , maxBatchSize   = parseIntEnv 100 ms
    , rateSource     = fromMaybe "internal" rs
    , enableOrdering = maybe True (\v -> v /= "0" && v /= "false") eo
    }

initState :: IO ProcessorState
initState = do
  po <- newTVarIO []
  pl <- newTVarIO []
  cr <- newTVarIO 1.0
  oc <- newTVarIO 0
  return ProcessorState
    { pendingOrders = po
    , processedLog = pl
    , currentRate  = cr
    , orderCounter = oc
    }

submitOrder :: ProcessorState -> Double -> String -> String -> IO Int
submitOrder state amount sender recv = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  atomically $ do
    ctr <- readTVar (orderCounter state)
    let newCtr = ctr + 1
    rate <- readTVar (currentRate state)
    let order = PaymentOrder
          { orderId     = newCtr
          , orderAmount = amount
          , orderSender = sender
          , orderRecv   = recv
          , orderRate   = rate
          , orderTime   = now
          }
    writeTVar (orderCounter state) newCtr
    modifyTVar' (pendingOrders state) (order :)
    return newCtr

updateRate :: ProcessorState -> Double -> IO ()
updateRate state newRate = atomically $ writeTVar (currentRate state) newRate

-- The batch processor collects orders and processes them
-- Orders are always sorted by submission time (FIFO)
-- This prevents front-running by ensuring temporal ordering
processBatch :: ProcessorConfig -> ProcessorState -> IO ()
processBatch config state = do
  threadDelay (batchWindow config)
  batch <- atomically $ do
    orders <- readTVar (pendingOrders state)
    writeTVar (pendingOrders state) []
    return orders
  unless (null batch) $ do
    let sorted = sortByArrival batch
    executeBatch state sorted

-- Sort by order ID which reflects arrival order
-- Note: list was built with cons (:) so newest is first
sortByArrival :: [PaymentOrder] -> [PaymentOrder]
sortByArrival = sortByField orderId

sortByField :: Ord b => (a -> b) -> [a] -> [a]
sortByField f = foldr (insertBy f) []

insertBy :: Ord b => (a -> b) -> a -> [a] -> [a]
insertBy _ x [] = [x]
insertBy f x (y:ys)
  | f x <= f y = x : y : ys
  | otherwise  = y : insertBy f x ys

executeBatch :: ProcessorState -> [PaymentOrder] -> IO ()
executeBatch state orders = atomically $ do
  forM_ orders $ \order -> do
    modifyTVar' (processedLog state) (order :)

-- Rate adjustment based on volume (read-only peek, no order details exposed)
adjustRateForVolume :: ProcessorState -> IO ()
adjustRateForVolume state = do
  pending <- atomically $ readTVar (pendingOrders state)
  let totalVol = sum (map orderAmount pending)
  when (totalVol > 10000) $ do
    atomically $ modifyTVar' (currentRate state) (* 1.001)

runProcessor :: IO (ProcessorState, ProcessorConfig)
runProcessor = do
  config <- loadConfig
  state <- initState
  void $ forkIO $ processorLoop config state
  return (state, config)

processorLoop :: ProcessorConfig -> ProcessorState -> IO ()
processorLoop config state = do
  adjustRateForVolume state
  processBatch config state
  processorLoop config state
